ValidationRule.description: Restricts Edit access for Renewal Opportunities
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( $Permission.Bypass_Restrict_Renewal_Opportunities ) , ( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Renewal" ) , OR( ISCHANGED( Name ) , ISCHANGED( OwnerId ) , ISCHANGED( StageName ) , ISCHANGED( NSP_AddonType__c ) , ISCHANGED( NSP_PrimaryProduct__c ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Only Renewal Specialists can modify Renewal Opportunities.
